verdict.rationale: The only first-party rule capability in the evidence is "Create risk rules and lists" for fraud prevention. These are configurable rules applied automatically to payment events, but the evidence is a single heading with no detail on rule conditions or resulting actions. Webhooks and EventBridge delivery only notify external systems; they are building blocks for automation, not in-product rule-triggered actions, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: a general-purpose event-to-action rules engine, documentation of rule conditions and actions, automation beyond fraud screening, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
